name: 98108 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98108 (Seattle) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98108 (Seattle) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98108 (Seattle) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
